title: ArchiveMute::reload_pending is cleared only by a successful settings answer; the error arm leaves it set
trigger: Server sends suggestedActionEnableArchiveAndMuteNewChats while the network is flaky (or send_json fails in reload_archive_chat_list_settings), so getArchiveChatListSettings fails. chat_list/error.rs resets archive_settings_loading but not archive_mute.reload_pending. Cached settings exist, so nothing reloads again.
effect: suggestion_due stays false for the rest of the session: the 'Hide new chats?' box never appears and the reload is never retried.
fix: Make the reload a stage enum (Idle, Reloading, Failed) owned by ArchiveMute and leave Reloading in the error arm and the send-failure arm of reload_archive_chat_list_settings.

title: reorderChatFolders and toggleChatFolderTags are applied optimistically with no rollback and no error arm
trigger: Drag a folder tab / flip folder tags while TDLib refuses or errors
effect: apply_folder_order / are_folder_tags_enabled stay at the refused value (no PendingRequest.rollback set, no arm in chat_list/error.rs) and no error line shows, until a later updateChatFolders
fix: Attach RequestRollback::{FolderOrder, FolderTags} like ChatPinOrder and add error arms.

title: select_chat_open sets session.open_chat before send_open_chat; a send error leaves the chat 'open' without openChat
trigger: Select a chat while the TDLib send fails once (native error)
effect: `?` returns Err but session.open_chat is set; re-selecting the same chat takes the 'already open' branch (line 56) and never sends openChat, so TDLib does not deliver open-chat updates/read marks for it
fix: Open as a stage (Opening/Open) with the TDLib openChat result, or roll back open_chat on error. Same in open_chat_window (chat_window.rs:29).

title: maybe_finish_leave_deletes takes the whole queue and drops the rest on the first error
trigger: Delete and leave several basic groups; leaveChat answers; the first removeChatFromList send returns Err (chats path inactive or native send failure)
effect: delete_after_leave was emptied with mem::take and `?` returns, so the failing chat and all later ones are never deleted: the group is left but stays in the chat list
fix: Peek/drain one at a time, or put unsent chat ids back on error (as maybe_finish_folder_removals does).

title: process_folder_new_chats removes the new-chats bar before the answer and nothing restores it on failure
trigger: Tap 'Add' or dismiss on the shared-folder new-chats bar and the request fails.
effect: The bar is gone, chats not joined, no error shown; fetch_folder_new_chats is also stamped once per period (asked is set before the send), so it does not come back for the period.
fix: Remove the bar on success only (or keep it Processing{request}) and stamp asked on answer.

title: Chat search, history calendar and date jump are session-wide and resolve their chat as chat_search.chat_id or open_chat
trigger: Search or jump to a date in a chat window while the main window has another chat open.
effect: send_chat_search, load_more_chat_search, search_from_members and fetch_history_around use session.open_chat (the main window's chat) when chat_search.chat_id is None; fetch_history_around (line 644) always uses open_chat while reset_history_window in jump_to_message_with may use chat_search.chat_id, so the window reset and the around-fetch can target different chats.
fix: Own the search and calendar in the chat's ChatUi and pass the chat id explicitly.

title: set_top_chats_disabled is optimistic and a refused setOption is never rolled back
trigger: Settings > turn off 'Suggest frequent contacts' while the setOption call fails (server error).
effect: top_chats_disabled=true and the strip is cleared locally; the error handler only sets a chat_action_error note, so the toggle shows the wrong value until restart and no refetch happens.
fix: Make the toggle a Pending{wanted}/Confirmed value; on error go back to the confirmed value and refetch top chats.

title: FolderEditor saves a snapshot of the folder spec taken when the box opened, overwriting later pin/include/exclude changes
trigger: Open Edit Folder (getChatFolder answered, editor prefilled from_spec), then while the box is open the folder changes (a chat is pinned in the folder from another window or device, a chat is removed through the remove-from-folder chain, the shared folder adds chats), then press Save.
effect: to_spec sends the old pinned_chat_ids, included/excluded sets and color_id in editChatFolder, silently undoing the newer change. ChatList already tracks folder_specs_stale so edits start from a fresh spec for removals, but the editor ignores it.
fix: Store the editor's base spec with its fetch generation as part of one stage enum and, on Save, refetch (or merge only the fields the person touched) when folder_specs_stale contains the folder.

title: folder_link_saved is a one-shot bool not tied to the folder or dialog that asked
trigger: Open the share dialog of folder A, create a link, close it, open folder B's share dialog before A's answer; or the answer lands after the dialog was reopened
effect: The answer sets folder_link_saved for any pending folder_id and the next drain flips whichever dialog is open back to the list view and clears busy
fix: Return the saved result as an event carrying the folder id, and apply it only when the open dialog is for that folder

title: getChatFolder failure gives no feedback when it was asked for the edit dialog or an edit chain
trigger: Edit a folder whose cached spec is stale; getChatFolder fails (offline/flood)
effect: Only the remove-from-folder queue case sets an error; the edit dialog waits on fresh_spec that never arrives (no failed stage), until reopened
fix: Fetch<ChatFolderSpec> per folder id, so Failed is a stage the dialog can show and retry.

title: Failed preview fetch overwrites the single preview slot of a different chat
trigger: Hover/peek chat A (getChatHistory out), then peek chat B; B answers, then A's request fails (or A answers late)
effect: The slot now holds A's failure/messages; B's preview finds no data for its chat and shows a spinner or error although it loaded
fix: Key previews by ChatId (HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<..>>) or drop an answer whose chat is not the one currently previewed; fetch_chat_preview_history only dedupes per chat but clears the shared slot.

title: A failed RemoveRecentlyFoundChat / RemoveTopChat does not restore the optimistic removal
trigger: Search > Recent: remove a recent chat or a frequent contact while the request fails.
effect: The row is gone locally and an error line is set, but the server still has it; it reappears only on the next refetch (restart).
fix: Carry the removed row in the purpose (like SetInactiveSessionTtl { previous }) and put it back in the error arm, or refetch the list on error.

title: A failed older page of in-chat search ends the results silently, no retry
trigger: Open in-chat search with more hits than one page, scroll to load the next page, drop the connection or get a flood error.
effect: next_from_message_id is zeroed so can_load_more is false for good: the list ends at N of M with no error and no Retry until the search is rerun.
fix: Keep the cursor and add a more_failed stage (as global search's SearchTabs::more_failed does) so the page can be retried; make the paging one enum (Idle, Loading, Failed, End).

title: Jump-to-date calendar flag lives in the Session and no farewell or chat leave closes it
trigger: Open a chat, open Jump to date, switch account (or leave the chat by another path), switch back.
effect: The session comes back with history_calendar still Some, so the JumpToDate dialog opens again over a chat that is no longer open; picking a day asks getChatMessageByDate for the old chat. date_jump and date_jump_note stay too.
fix: Close it in leave_open_chat (clear history_calendar, date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note) and in SearchUi's Farewell via close_jump_date_ui; better, hold the calendar in the open chat's view value.

title: Choosing a folder or entering community mode while the Calls tab is open leaves the Calls tab showing
trigger: Open the Calls tab, then click a folder in the folder rail (open_folder_tab) or 'View chats' in the community hub (enter_community_chat_list_mode).
effect: Both clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so sidebar_ready keeps drawing the calls list; the folder/community filter changes underneath with no visible effect.
fix: enum SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls } set in one function; the folder and community starters set Chats.

title: Folder step and community mode clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open, so the Calls tab stays over a folder switch
trigger: Open the sidebar Calls tab, then press the Next/Previous Folder shortcut (NextFolder/PrevFolder -> step_folder_by_key -> open_folder_tab), or click a community row's View chats (enter_community_chat_list_mode, line 294)
effect: The folder or community view changes invisibly under the Calls list; the same step from the Contacts tab returns to the chats, from Calls it does nothing visible. open_archive_folder (archive_row.rs:114) and open_chats_tab clear both flags, these two clear only one
fix: Replace the two bools with one `SidebarTab { Chats, Contacts, Calls }` enum so any view change sets `Chats` in one write.

title: open_folder_tab and enter_community_chat_list_mode clear contacts_tab_open but not calls_tab_open
trigger: Open the Calls tab in the sidebar, then press the folder-switch shortcut (shortcut_pack.rs:617 -> open_folder_tab) or Escape (chat_list_keys.rs:618 -> open_folder_tab(None)) or enter a community chat-list mode from the hub
effect: The folder/filter changes underneath but the sidebar keeps drawing the Calls panel and the Calls tab stays highlighted; the chat list the user asked for is not shown until the Chats tab is clicked
fix: Replace the two bools with SidebarTab; open_folder_tab and enter_community_chat_list_mode set SidebarTab::Chats.

title: Pinned order is sent from the ids snapshotted at drag start
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat, meanwhile unpin another chat (or pin one) on another device, then release.
effect: finish_pin_drag sends set_pinned_chat_order(archived, reorder.ids) built from the pre-drag list, re-pinning the chat that was unpinned (or dropping the new pin); an Err leaves the displayed order until the slide settles with only a note.
fix: Re-read session.pinned_chat_ids at release and reapply the dragged move to it; reject the drop when the set differs.

title: Bulk pin passes the pin-limit pre-check for every chat because the session count lags the in-flight requests
trigger: Select 5 chats with 2 free pin slots and press Pin: toggle_selected_pins calls toggle_chat_pin per chat; each pre-check counts only server-confirmed pins.
effect: Five setPinned requests are sent; the extra ones fail on the server, each with its own note overwriting the previous (set_note), so the user sees one or no error and a partly pinned result with the selection already cleared.
fix: Count the requested-but-unanswered pins in the pre-check (pending pin set in the session) and stop the batch with the limit box at the first refusal.

title: Add Contact box closes when addContact is sent; a TDLib error is silently dropped
trigger: Open a user's profile > Add Contact, enter a phone number TDLib refuses (or hit a server error), press Add Contact.
effect: The box closes with 'Contact add requested' and nothing else. apply_users_error has no arm for RequestPurpose::AddContact (only AddContactByPhone), so the user never learns that the add failed.
fix: Keep the box open in a Saving stage until the answer (match by request id), then close on ok or show the error in the box.

title: Folder editor stays on 'Loading folder' forever when getChatFolder fails
trigger: Edit a folder whose spec is not cached (or stale) while getChatFolder is refused (folder removed on another device) or the send fails (driver not active).
effect: The editor shows the name field and 'Loading folder...' with no form and no error; fetch_pending is cleared only by prefill_from_spec on success. The GetChatFolder error arm (state/domains/chat_list/error.rs:87) only prunes folder_remove_queue and never reaches dialog.error; the send-failure arm only sets a status note. Closing and reopening is the only way out.
fix: Replace fetch_pending/error with an enum FolderForm { Loading(RequestId), Ready, Failed(String) }; the GetChatFolder error and send Err move it to Failed.

title: Share Folder save answer is not matched to the form that sent it
trigger: Edit a link and press Save (busy), press Cancel (busy cleared, back to List), start 'Create link' (view Edit), then the first save's answer lands.
effect: drain_folder_share applies the unkeyed session flag folder_link_saved (and folder_share_error) to whatever the dialog shows now: the view is reset to List and the new form is dropped, or the error text is shown on the wrong form.
fix: One enum Link { Idle, Saving(RequestId) } on the dialog; the answer carries the request id and is applied only to the matching Saving.

title: A folder-limit hit clears the busy/adding state of every open folder dialog, not the one that hit it
trigger: Folder invite dialog adding chats and a folder share dialog busy creating a link are both open (share from a chat window, invite in main); the invite request hits the limit
effect: share.busy is cleared too, so the share dialog's Create can be pressed twice; the limit box goes to whichever dialog the invite-first guess picks
fields: FoldersUi::share.busy, FoldersUi::invite.adding, ChatListState::folder_limit_hit (single Option, no request key)
fix: Carry the asker (FolderInvite/FolderShare/Editor and request id) in folder_limit_hit and fail only that dialog's Fetch/Busy stage.

title: Share Folder stays on 'Loading folder...' / 'Loading links...' when the fetch fails
trigger: Open Share Folder for a folder without a fresh cached spec while getChatFolder fails (connection drop, folder removed on another device) or the send itself errors.
effect: folder_link_list shows 'Loading folder...' forever: the GetChatFolder error arm stores nothing and the send error only toasts. Only Done gets out.
fix: Track the share box's spec and links as Fetch<T> per folder (Loading/Ready/Failed) so the error arm leaves Loading and the box can show the error and retry.

title: Share Folder dialog applies session-wide one-shot flags (folder_link_saved, folder_share_error) to whatever view is on screen
trigger: Save a new invite link (busy), press Cancel (view = List, busy cleared), click New link again and start filling the form; the earlier save answer arrives. Or a GetRecommendedChatFolders / delete-link error arrives while the dialog is open.
effect: drain_folder_share takes folder_link_saved/folder_share_error unmatched to folder, link or request and sets view = List and clears the form being edited, or shows an unrelated error in the dialog and clears busy of a request still in flight.
fix: Carry the request id in FolderShareDialog::Saving{request} and match the answer's id; make errors a per-request result, not a shared Option.

title: Add-folder-by-link box shows 'Checking link...' forever when checkChatFolderInviteLink cannot be sent
trigger: Click a t.me/addlist link while the chats path is not active yet (just after connect) or while sending fails.
effect: open_folder_invite only toasts the send error; folder_invite_info and folder_invite_error stay None so the box spins 'Checking link...' with only Close. When chats_path_active() is false the driver returns before resetting folder_invite_info, so info left from an earlier link (e.g. a box dropped by an account switch, which has no Farewell clearing the session fields) can be shown under the new link.
fix: Keep the check as one enum on the dialog (Checking{request}/Checked(info)/Failed(err)/Adding{request}/Done) set from the send result too; the session answers keyed by request id.

title: Recommended folder 'Add' can be clicked twice and creates two folders
trigger: Settings > Folders: click Add on a recommended folder twice (or double-click) before updateChatFolders adds the folder to the list.
effect: The row is hidden only once a folder with that name exists in chat_folders; until then each click sends createChatFolder again, giving duplicates (or a limit box). The index ix is also captured at render and read against recommended_folders at click time, so a refreshed list between render and click adds a different recommendation.
fix: Track recommended adds as a per-recommendation Adding stage keyed by the recommendation's name; resolve by key, not index.

title: Folder editor closes and toasts 'Folder updated/created' when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Open Edit Folder (or New Folder), choose a state the server refuses (name TDLib rejects, a limit the local check does not know such as FILTER_*_TOO_MUCH / DIALOG_FILTERS_TOO_MUCH, or go offline), press Save.
effect: save_folder_editor sets folders.editor = None and shows the silent 'Folder updated' note as soon as driver.edit_chat_folder/create_chat_folder returns Ok(request id). The failure arrives later through state::domains::chat_list::error (limit box or generic error) after the editor and its typed input are gone, so the person sees a success note followed by an error and loses the edits.
fix: Keep the editor as a Saving(request) stage of one enum (Editing, Saving(RequestId), Failed(text)); close it only on the matching answer and show the error inside it.

title: Add to folder box spins 'Loading folder options...' forever when getChatListsToAddChat fails
trigger: Open a chat's Add to folder box while the request fails (offline, error answer).
effect: folder_menu_panel shows the loading line until chat_lists_for_add has the chat; no error arm handles GetChatListsToAddChat, and the send error only toasts. Only closing the box gets out.
fix: Hold the box's destinations as Fetch<Vec<ChatList>> keyed by chat, with the error arm moving it to Failed.

title: Opening a found chat/message proceeds in the UI when the driver refused
trigger: Click a search result while select_search_chat_open/select_search_message fails (flush_leaving_composer or select_chat returns Err, e.g. not Ready).
effect: Error note is shown, but enter_chat_ui, restore_open_draft and clearing the search field still run: the chat UI is entered for a chat that is not open (fixed up later by sync_chat_ui), the search stays open in the session with an emptied field and stale results.
fix: Return early on Err (or make the open an enum result) and only then enter the chat UI and clear the field.

title: Render-driven load-more asks every frame when the request is refused (no more_failed set)
trigger: Search results open with a next page (has_more) scrolled near the end while the client is shutting down or not Ready (chats_path_active false), e.g. during log out/close.
effect: Each frame defers maybe_load_more_search -> load_more_search_ui -> load_more_search_results returns Err(InvalidRequest) without begin_more/fail_page, so loading_more/more_failed never change; every frame sets an error note and cx.notify(): a redraw/request loop and repeated error toasts. In a demo session (no live) load_more_search_ui only notifies, same loop if has_more.
fix: Make paging a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading/Failed) on SearchTabsState and have the UI path set Failed on any Err, not just on a send error.
